body:
Author-side fixes applied for the four review findings on `4fa788688`.
The new branch head is `2e77ca0eea042aaf581b6cee65fb09c583886f29`.

### Findings addressed

1. **Merge conflicts with `upstream/main`:** Merged `upstream/main` (`9e10d7030`) into `issue/1864-contour-dxf-sketches` (`a76e13245`).
   - Kept `prev.setup.as_deref()` in `crates/app/src/commands/operation/geometry.rs`.
   - Kept `setup: Option<&str>` on `probe_seed` in `crates/app/src/operation/probe_pick.rs`.
   - Reconciled `crates/app/src/project/area.rs` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/params_page.rs`.
   - Checked `git merge-tree` against current `upstream/main` (`a85900ac5`): clean, zero conflicts.
   - Pinned by `app suites: probe_pick`, `app suites: deburr_edge_filters`, and `app suites: project_roundtrip`.

2. **Before and after UI screenshots:** Pushed `2716/before.png`, `2716/after-whole-sketch.png`, and `2716/after-layer-pick.png` (`1600 x 960`) to `origin/pr-screenshots` (`f597f48a5c3f2b22381af8f140ce3d12c3d251cf`).
   - Kept zero screenshots on the PR branch.
   - `gh pr edit` (`gh 2.46.0`) failed with GitHub's `repository.pullRequest.projectCards` GraphQL sunset error, and `gh api` is blocked here.
   - The Markdown table is below so a maintainer can paste it into the PR body under `## UI screenshots`.

3. **Whole-sketch `SrcRef::Entity` selection in `op_page.rs`:** Updated `header_rows` in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_page.rs` to include `camcraft_app::sketch::placed_in` entities in `models`.
   - The `Source` combo keeps placed DXF sketches selected and shows per-chain overrides before any layer click.
   - Pinned by `egui_app::tests::contour_dxf_sketch::whole_sketch_entity_source_stays_selected_and_shows_per_chain_overrides_before_layer_click` (mutation verified: RED when removed, GREEN when restored).

4. **Per-frame sketch work behind input-keyed caches (`docs/decisions/2238-frame-cost-rule.md`):**
   - **Auto side (`selection.rs`, `selection_memo.rs`, `picks.rs`):** Routed `contour_auto_side` through `selection_memo::answer` for both `SrcRef::Selection` and `SrcRef::Entity`. Pinned by `operation::selection_memo::tests::contour_auto_side_routes_whole_sketch_through_selection_memo` (mutation verified).
   - **Chain overrides (`fields.rs`, `operation/sketch_memo.rs`):** Added memoized `operation::sketch_chain_infos` and timed `sketch_chain_overrides_ui` with `frame_cost::time`. Pinned by `operation::sketch_memo::tests::sketch_chain_infos_and_z_range_memoize_per_input_and_track_changes` and `egui_app::tests::contour_dxf_sketch::sketch_frame_caches_skip_still_frames_and_track_changed_inputs` (mutation verified).
   - **Layer picker (`geo_page.rs`, `crates/ui/src/sketch_memo.rs`):** Added UI memoized `sketch_layers` and timed `sketch_layer_picks` with `frame_cost::time`. Pinned by `egui_app::tests::contour_dxf_sketch::sketch_frame_caches_skip_still_frames_and_track_changed_inputs` (mutation verified).
   - **Z range and unresolved note (`operation/sketch_memo.rs`, `height_memo.rs`, `operations.rs`):** Memoized `sketch_z_range` and `height_memo::unresolved_note`. Pinned by `operation::sketch_memo::tests::sketch_chain_infos_and_z_range_memoize_per_input_and_track_changes` and `egui_app::tests::contour_dxf_sketch::sketch_frame_caches_skip_still_frames_and_track_changed_inputs` (mutation verified).

### Verification on `2e77ca0eea042aaf581b6cee65fb09c583886f29`

- `cargo xtask gate batch --only "ui suites" --only clippy`: 26 passed, 0 failed (`ui` suites and workspace `clippy -D warnings`).
- `cargo xtask gate batch --only "app suites"`: 568 passed, 1 failed (`feature_edge_g1_join::no_pickable_edge_is_a_tangent_piece_of_a_longer_one_in_any_step_fixture` failed on pre-existing `testdata/models/bar_cross_holes.step` from upstream `371813425`).
- Earlier `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (fell back to `batch`) passed steps 1 to 512 except `kernel suites: step_agreement` (`bar_cross_holes.step` from `371813425`), before a server restart stopped step 513.
- Targeted unit checks on `2e77ca0ee`: `camcraft-app --lib` (`selection_memo`, `sketch_memo`: 2 passed, 0 failed); `camcraft-ui --lib` (`contour_dxf_sketch`: 3 passed, 0 failed).

### UI screenshots (for PR body)

These images show the `2D Contour` Properties panel and Viewport on a 100 x 80 x 10 mm stock block (`1600 x 960` headless software WGPU render, stored only on `origin/pr-screenshots` at `f597f48a5c3f2b22381af8f140ce3d12c3d251cf`).

Needs changes before merge. This is a safety-tier review.

### Requested before merge

1. **Keep open chains out of excluded areas.** `crates/app/src/operation/contour_sketch.rs:281` appends open chains without the Boundary controls. The guard at line 210 refuses only selections with no closed loop. A mixed selection bypasses that guard.

   I selected a closed circle and an open line. I set `Exclude Stock` for stock at X=50..70, Y=0..20, Z=0..10. Generation accepted a feed from `(20, 10, 8)` to `(100, 10, 8)`, through the excluded stock. The warning list was empty. Apply the exclusions to open chains, or refuse this combination. Add a test for mixed closed and open selections.

2. **Keep the cutting side unchanged when only Reverse changes.** `crates/app/src/operation/contour_sketch.rs:228`, with the grouping condition at line 183, changes the side rule between grouped and separate generation.

   I selected a rectangle from one sketch and a nested R10 circle from a second sketch. Both descriptors reported `Auto: Outside`. With a 4 mm tool, the normal circle path had radius `7.99995`. Changing only the circle's Reverse override produced radius `11.99996`. Direction must not change the offset side. Resolve the side consistently before choosing the generation path. Add a test with nested loops from separate sketches.

3. **Invalidate both sketch highlight caches when stock placement changes.** `crates/ui/src/pick_highlight.rs:83` prefers `view_pose` over `sketch_pose`. For a sketch, that retains its local pose. The new sketch branch at `crates/ui/src/interact.rs:1730` also uses `pick_line_memo`, whose key omits the sketch's stock-relative world pose.

   After stock height changed from 10 to 25, fresh sketch points had Z=25. The cached hover and selected overlay both stayed at Z=10. Use the sketch world pose in both keys. Include the drawing allocation where the build reads it. Add stock-move and stock-height tests.

4. **Put the before and after screenshots in the PR body.** The UI changes at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/geo_page.rs:123` still have no screenshots in the body. The author supplied image links in a comment. Copy that image table into the body. Keep the files only on `pr-screenshots`.

5. **Resolve the new conflicts with current main before merge.** The initial trial merge with `971c23faa026865be47e425a660439f8c3d17ecd` was clean. Main advanced during this review. GitHub now reports `CONFLICTING` against `475373093cde8974c467a6855693cbdadf4827a4`. A local `git merge-tree` check confirms conflicts in:

   - `crates/app/src/commands/operation/geometry.rs:87`
   - `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`
   - `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`
   - `crates/app/tests/model_link.rs`

   Keep both sets of fields and the required project migrations. Run the final gate after the permitted branch refresh and the review fixes.

### Local build and tests

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2716`. No GitHub runner was used.

The reviewed trial merge used upstream main `971c23faa026865be47e425a660439f8c3d17ecd`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` selected the batch fallback: **924 steps, one failed step**, 114.7 minutes.
- The initial build passed. All geometry, kernel, tools, post, simulation, motion, and application steps passed.
- Application unit tests: **392 passed, one ignored**.
- `contour_dxf_sketch`: **3 passed**. `contour_dxf_sketch_verify`: **3 passed**.
- `project_roundtrip`: **76 passed**. UI `contour_dxf_sketch`: **2 passed**.
- UI unit tests: **1252 passed, 4 failed, 7 ignored**. The other UI steps passed.
- Clippy with `--all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

The four UI failures share `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/frame_cost_probe.rs:278`:

```text
the area preview is filled
```

The failing tests were:

- `egui_app::tests::frame_cost_caches::pick_chips_group_the_welded_faces_once_and_follow_the_picks`
- `egui_app::tests::frame_cost_caches::pick_lines_build_once_per_input`
- `egui_app::tests::frame_cost_probe::area_preview_fill_is_made_once_per_draft`
- `egui_app::tests::frame_cost_probe::still_frames_on_fig8_name_their_costs`

I re-ran `area_preview_fill_is_made_once_per_draft` alone. It failed on the trial merge and on main `971c23faa`. It passed on newer main `475373093`, which contains the fixture fix from #2767. This failure is inherited from the original main revision. The full gate still needs a green result after refresh.

### Extra suites run

These named targets ran locally as gate steps:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`: **20 passed**.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test machining_mesh`: **7 passed**.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join`: **5 passed**.

The earlier STEP failures did not reproduce. This PR changes no fixture directory or importer source.

### Mutations and goldens

I re-ran two mutations from the PR:

- Removed the Contour admission arm in `sketch_model::generation_problem`. `whole_plate_auto_nesting_cuts_outer_outside_holes_inside_and_preserves_g2_g3_arcs` failed, then passed after restoration: **RED / GREEN**.
- Bypassed the open-side and open-control-compensation guards in `contour_sketch::validate_plan`. `open_chain_safety_refuses_side_compensation_and_g41_by_name` failed, then passed after restoration: **RED / GREEN**.

Three additional local probes reproduced findings 1–3. All temporary source changes were restored. No review evidence was committed or pushed.

No NC, CL, or snapshot PNG golden changed. I checked the example project diff line by line: only its version changes from 72 to 73. The body has `Process change: yes`; the PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.

The earlier whole-sketch Source and frame-cache fixes have passing tests. The screenshot requirement remains open. Release-only ignored tests and interactive viewport rendering were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
